testImpact.isolation: Injected GitHub/provider fixtures and disposable native tool seams; configured exact-SHA parent verification provider for final integrated delivery

risks: Seven refined children total 52 human hours; the separate parent orchestration baseline is 2h. Rubric calibration and unavoidable repository execution add transparent planning adjustments, not measured child work.
Only Tasks 3 and 4 are disjoint concurrent candidates; shared inventory and formal review handoffs are serialized. Summed human effort is not parallel elapsed time.
Private marker capability must protect existing advance consumers; pending/unknown publication cannot be cleared by old matching fields or kind conversion.
Fresh hook collection must meet bounded fixture latency and call-count budgets; provider authority failure remains typed indeterminate.
Scope preparation remains available under original authority while new substantive deliverable/completion evidence stays restricted.

The 30-minute execution allowance is a conservative planning assumption, not benchmark evidence. Task baselines include implementation/test authoring and review; final unavoidable isolated execution is separately calibrated.
